conventions.frame: 2D sagittal image coordinates, x = running direction (clip mirrored if needed), y = up
conventions.trunk: pitch of hip-midpoint -> shoulder-midpoint line from vertical, + = forward lean (upright 0, horizontal 90)
conventions.thigh: hip->knee angle from straight down, + = knee forward of hip
conventions.shank: knee->ankle angle from straight down, + = ankle forward of knee
conventions.hip: thigh relative to trunk line = thigh + trunk (0 in line, + flexion, - extension)
conventions.ankle: angle(shank vector knee-ankle, foot vector heel->foot_index) - 90, + = plantarflexion, 0 = neutral standing foot
conventions.shoulder: upper arm (shoulder->elbow) relative to trunk downward direction (shoulder->hip), + = arm forward (flexion)
conventions.roles_run: st_ = stance leg / leg whose event it is, sw_ = contralateral leg; st_shoulder/st_elbow = arm on the stance-leg side
conventions.roles_mkl: maxv_mkl: sw_ = leg at maximum thigh flexion (the knee-lift leg), st_ = contralateral leg at that instant
conventions.roles_blocks: front_ = leg in the front block, rear_ = leg in the rear block; front_shoulder = arm on the front-leg side
conventions.foot_ahead: (stance ankle x - hip-midpoint x) at touchdown / leg length (hip-ankle, straight leg)
conventions.heights: set-position hip / shoulder height above the hand line (wrists on the track) / leg length

method.pose: MediaPipe Tasks PoseLandmarker, heavy model (mediapipe 0.10.14, CPU), VIDEO mode, on a 512x512 crop that follows Bolt (kit colour check to reject other people; red official masked in the Nitro clip)
method.coordinates: image -> runner frame (x forward, y up), rotated by the lane-line slope at the feet (Hough lines)
method.identity: left/right labels resolved per frame by a Viterbi pass over ankle/heel/toe continuity; frames where both labels sit on one limb are dropped; in the block clip the labels are pinned by the ground contact sites (rear block, front block, step 1, step 2 alternate legs), after removing the phone's pan measured by phase correlation of the background
method.near_far: near leg = right (visible side for left-to-right running); by MediaPipe visibility in the running clips, by rear-block assignment in the block clip (Bolt's right foot is in the rear block)
method.smoothing: median-filter outlier rejection (0.12 leg lengths), gap fill up to 6 frames, Savitzky-Golay (window 7 frames/cubic at 240 fps; 9/cubic at 60 fps; 5/quadratic at 25 fps) - keeps the knee swing peaks (window << 1/4 stride)
method.events_run: contact while the lowest of heel/toe is within 0.10 leg lengths of the local ground (running min over 1.5 strides), checked against hand-marked frames (+-1 frame); contacts must alternate legs
method.events_blocks: contact while toe or heel stays on its ground-fixed contact site (within 0.06 leg lengths) and low (0.12); block exits = end of contact on the blocks; onset = hinge fit of forward trunk position
method.roles: running: both legs' roles from the near leg (st_ at its own events, sw_ at the far leg's events); blocks: front_ = far leg, rear_ = near leg; steps: st_ = the leg in contact

set.note: rep3 only (rep1 is a rolling start with no still set hold). LOW RELIABILITY: Bolt wears all-black in a compact crouch; overlays show MediaPipe placing both knees behind/below the hips and the shoulder line jumping between frames, so the knee and trunk values disagree strongly with every published set position (knees 87/59 deg, trunk ~109 deg). Use `literature` for the simulator's set pose; hip_height and shoulder_height are above the track level measured from step-1 stance.
set.arms: Arm angles come from the near arm only and are the least reliable numbers here: the arm crossing in front of the torso is poorly localised (forward shoulder flexion is probably underestimated), and values with SD > 30 deg are moved to angles_low_confidence.

literature.source: W18 (world-class men, WIC 2018); Bolt-specific set angles not found

trunk_by_step_meta.model: MODEL (not video): exponential blend, tau = 11.4 steps
trunk_by_step_meta.note: steps 1-2 and block exit are Bolt video (Nitro 2017, n=2 reps); steps 3+ are an exponential blend from the video step-1/2 lean to the Daegu max-velocity lean (NOT measured). For comparison the 2018 world-indoor 60 m finalists (W18) lean 51/47, 47/45, 44/42 deg (TD/TO) at steps 1-3, about 7 deg more than Bolt here; NAG14 puts the end of the lean-to-upright transition near step 14 and upper-trunk lean ~14 deg at step 25.

blocks.clock_note: capture rate measured from the 100 Hz flicker of the stadium lights (50 Hz mains, Melbourne) aliased to ~0.417 cycles/frame: 100/0.417 = 240 fps, i.e. an iPhone-style 240 fps slow-motion played at 30 fps (8x). Frame resolution 4.2 ms; event uncertainty about +-2-5 frames (+-8-20 ms), onset about +-10 frames.
blocks.note: onset = first forward movement of hips/shoulders (hinge fit), only for rep3 (rep1 has no still set hold). Practice starts without a gun, so there is no reaction time; the literature 'block time' (gun to front-foot exit) = reaction + onset_to_block_exit.

max_velocity.timebase: UNKNOWN for both running clips (broadcast slow-motion of unstated factor; no mains flicker detectable). Durations are given in video frames and as ratios; absolute values need an assumed clock.

maxv_vs_L17_bolt_2017.summary: [video (Daegu), literature]. Thigh angles, knee at toe-off, contact fraction of the step and step length agree. The video trunk is ~10-13 deg more upright and the stance knee straighter at touchdown (by ~15 deg) and the stance thigh less extended at toe-off (by ~10-14 deg) than Bolt's 2017 values. Likely causes: different task (Daegu = 200 m preliminary round, home straight, not the 100 m at 50 m), MediaPipe's hip/shoulder centres vs. manual joint markers, a +-2.5 deg lane-tilt correction, and event timing at an unknown frame rate (a 1-frame shift changes thigh angles by ~5-8 deg).

blocks_vs_W18.summary: [video (Nitro 2017), literature]. Push-phase timing agrees within ~0.01-0.03 s (onset uncertain by ~0.04 s). Bolt's first contact is ~0.05 s longer and the flights after block exit and step 1 are ~0.03 s shorter than the 2018 world-indoor 60 m finalists (a practice start; contact ends are the least certain events, +-2-5 frames). Bolt is ~7-8 deg more upright than the 60 m finalists at block exit and steps 1-2. The set-position angles from this footage are wrong (see events.set.note): use the literature set pose.

agreement.far_vs_near_limb_note: events.maxv_*.far_limb_direct gives the same roles measured on the far leg at its own events; the difference to the near-leg values is the far-limb 2D error

scaling.rule: Froude similarity with L = hip-ankle length: v ~ sqrt(g L), t ~ sqrt(L / g), f ~ sqrt(g / L), distances ~ L; angles unchanged
scaling.distances: foot_ahead, hip_height, shoulder_height and step lengths are already in leg lengths (hip-ankle)
